decisions.decision: Retain mandatory exact candidate workflow_dispatch validation and add a separate protected-main strict validator that publishes the required bootstrap as a classic commit status only after complete PR/base/head/current-merge/path/blob/provenance/no-drift validation succeeds.
decisions.rationale: Live acceptance showed that candidate workflow check success and an additional manual check-run were not accepted by the strict gate, while the fingerprint-bound classic status after full trusted validation made the generated PR clean without weakening governance.

decisions.decision: Keep strict status publication in an isolated job with read permissions plus statuses:write, separate from the historical-ledger publisher mutation job.
decisions.rationale: This supplies only the minimum new repository-scoped capability required to report trusted validation; it grants no contents write, PR write, approval, merge, or direct-main authority to the gate.

decisions.decision: Preserve exact paths-ignore only for claims/claims.jsonl and claims/conflicts.json and preserve ordinary pull_request, push main, workflow_dispatch, required bootstrap name, integration 15368, and pinned actions.
decisions.rationale: Generated-only canonical publication keeps zero automatic PR runs while mixed, wrong-path, source, governance, and protected-main changes retain ordinary CI coverage.

decisions.decision: Use mergeable_state=clean under the unchanged strict ruleset as sandbox-equivalent end-to-end eligibility proof and close the generated acceptance PR unmerged.
decisions.rationale: Actually merging disposable historical-ledger bytes would mutate production hwm-context/main, which the remediation acceptance boundary explicitly forbids; clean merge eligibility proves the gate without that unsafe side effect.
